title: Test case 2 — Stabbing of a paramedic during a psychotic episode (s 16, protected official)
shows: The statutory schemes: Category 1 and a 3-year minimum non-parole period because the victim was a paramedic on duty and the offender knew it (the form confirms the protected-official scheme applied at the offence date — the Manual gives no commencement date, so the app asks); whether a special reason (mental impairment) is made out on the psychiatric evidence; the limited dispositions a special reason opens (imprisonment without a CCO, or a mandatory treatment and monitoring order on the therapeutic-order conditions); and the Manual's own problems on these points, shown as cautions with their flags rather than resolved.
